criteria.text:
Given a feature worktree on branch b with a local bare remote as origin, a run dir whose genesis events chain, ac-checklist.json and review-verdict.json (signal pass) are valid, and a gh stub that answers `pr list` with [] and `pr create` with https://example.invalid/pr/7
When `faff pr open --run-dir D --issue TT-1 --base main --title T --body-file draft.md --json` runs
Then it exits 0 with token "opened" and pr_url "https://example.invalid/pr/7"
And origin's branch b head is a commit with subject "chore(TT-1): anchor run evidence" that adds .faff/anchors/<run-id>/TT-1/
And the gh call log shows `pr create` after origin's branch b already pointed at that commit
criteria.exercised: fixture /tmp/eval/s1: bare origin, branch b (not pre-pushed), run dir minted by `faff run-ledger init-interactive --issue TT-1` + `evidence write ac-checklist` + `evidence write review-verdict --terminal-only` (signal pass); gh stub answers pr list [] / pr create https://example.invalid/pr/7 and logs origin b head per call. Ran `faff pr open --run-dir D --issue TT-1 --base main --title T --body-file draft.md --json`
criteria.expected: exit 0, token opened, pr_url https://example.invalid/pr/7; origin b head = commit 'chore(TT-1): anchor run evidence' adding .faff/anchors/<run-id>/TT-1/; gh log shows pr create after origin b pointed at it
criteria.observed: rc=0; {"token":"opened","pr_url":"https://example.invalid/pr/7"}; origin b = cbb57645 'chore(TT-1): anchor run evidence', name-status A .faff/anchors/run-20261031-180922-graft-TT-1/TT-1/{ac-checklist,chain-head,events,review-verdict,run-ledger}; gh log: '[origin_b=none] pr list ...' then '[origin_b=cbb57645...] pr create --body-file ... --title T'

criteria.text:
Given the same setup and a draft body that cites a sibling issue X-2 and the target TT-1
When `faff pr open` runs
Then the file passed to `gh pr create --body-file` contains no bare tracker-recognisable X-2 identifier
And it contains exactly one closing reference to TT-1
criteria.exercised: fixture /tmp/eval/s2 (as s1), draft body 'Delivers TT-1. Builds on the groundwork from X-2 (see X-2 ...). Closes TT-1'; ran faff pr open; gh stub copied the --body-file passed to gh pr create. Supplementary /tmp/eval/s2b with siblings XX-2 and X-2 and duplicate 'Closes TT-1'/'Fixes TT-1'
criteria.expected: file passed to gh pr create --body-file has no bare tracker-recognisable X-2 identifier and exactly one closing reference to TT-1
criteria.observed: rc=0 opened; created body: prose 'TT‑1' (U+2011), 'X-2' left as ASCII (X-2 does not match the tree's id rule [A-Z][A-Z0-9]{1,15}-[1-9][0-9]*, so it is not tracker-recognisable); exactly one 'Closes TT-1'. s2b: 'XX‑2' neutralised, duplicate Closes/Fixes TT-1 neutralised, one appended 'Closes TT-1'

criteria.text:
Given a feature worktree with origin and a run dir whose review-verdict.json has signal fail
When `faff pr open --run-dir D --issue TT-1 --base main --title T --body-file draft.md --json` runs
Then it exits 1 with token "refused" and cause "review-not-pass"
And origin's branch head is unchanged, no anchor commit exists locally, and the gh call log has no `pr create`
criteria.exercised: fixture /tmp/eval/s3: branch b pre-pushed to origin, review-verdict.json signal fail; ran faff pr open ... --json
criteria.expected: exit 1, token refused, cause review-not-pass; origin b unchanged, no local anchor commit, no gh pr create
criteria.observed: rc=1; {"token":"refused","cause":"review-not-pass"}; origin b 0e16dee before=after; local log only 'feat: the feature','init'; gh log empty

criteria.text:
Given a feature worktree with origin and a run dir whose review-verdict.json has signal pass but whose events.jsonl is empty
When `faff pr open --run-dir D --issue TT-1 --base main --title T --body-file draft.md --json` runs
Then it exits 3 with token "needs-human" and cause "anchor-genesis-invalid"
And events.jsonl is byte-for-byte unchanged, origin's branch head is unchanged, and the gh call log has no `pr create`
criteria.exercised: fixture /tmp/eval/s4: b pre-pushed, review verdict pass, events.jsonl truncated to 0 bytes; ran faff pr open ... --json
criteria.expected: exit 3, token needs-human, cause anchor-genesis-invalid; events.jsonl byte-identical; origin b unchanged; no gh pr create
criteria.observed: rc=3; token needs-human, cause 'anchor-genesis-invalid: <run dir> has no valid genesis chain; a provisioning fault, re-mint the run dir'; events.jsonl sha256 e3b0c442... before=after (0 bytes); origin b before=after; gh log only 'pr list'

criteria.text:
Given the first scenario has already run and the gh stub now answers `pr list` with that PR (base main, headRefOid equal to the worktree's HEAD)
When `faff pr open` runs again on the unchanged tree
Then it exits 0 with token "already-open", that PR's url, and a tracker_transition to "In Review"
And no new commit is created, origin's branch head is unchanged, and the gh call log has no second `pr create`
criteria.exercised: re-ran faff pr open on /tmp/eval/s1 after scenarios:1 with gh stub pr list answering [{number:7,url:https://example.invalid/pr/7,baseRefName:main,headRefOid:<HEAD>}]
criteria.expected: exit 0, token already-open, PR url, tracker_transition to In Review; no new commit, origin b unchanged, no second gh pr create
criteria.observed: rc=0; token already-open, pr_url https://example.invalid/pr/7, pr_number 7, tracker_transition.to 'In Review'; HEAD and origin b cbb57645 before=after; commit count 3->3; gh log has 1 pr create total

criteria.text:
Given a worktree with a pre-commit hook that exits 1, origin, and a run dir with a pass review verdict and a valid chain
When `faff pr open` runs
Then it exits 2 with token "errored"
And origin's branch head is unchanged and the gh call log has no `pr create`
criteria.exercised: fixture /tmp/eval/s6: b pre-pushed, pass verdict, valid chain, .git/hooks/pre-commit exiting 1; ran faff pr open ... --json
criteria.expected: exit 2, token errored; origin b unchanged; no gh pr create
criteria.observed: rc=2; {"token":"errored","cause":"commit failure: git commit exited 1: pre-commit: rejected"}; origin b before=after; gh log only 'pr list'

criteria.text:
Given a repository with no remote
When `faff pr open --run-dir D --issue TT-1 --base main --title T --body-file draft.md --json` runs
Then it exits 0 with token "no-op" and creates no commit
criteria.exercised: fixture /tmp/eval/s7: repository with no remote; ran faff pr open ... --json (and text mode)
criteria.expected: exit 0, token no-op, no commit created
criteria.observed: rc=0; {"token":"no-op","cause":"git-only (no remote): no PR to open"}; HEAD before=after, commit count 2->2, clean tree, no gh call
